caption_en: Calendar coverage of 91 station IDs in 2017–2024. Denominators are 105,120 five-minute timestamp slots per non-leap year and 105,408 in 2020/2024. Zero observed coverage means no valid observations, not zero rainfall.

Mean observed rainfall per valid five-minute slot and wet fraction under changing network, fixed cohort, station-specific matched calendar and restricted joint support. Primary station-specific comparison uses 20 equal-weighted stations and 1,318,195 observations per year. Joint support covers five months only; neither panel estimates complete national annual rainfall.

Availability of eight-year shared calendar positions by month. Each station has its own shared positions; the joint panel has 3,976 positions in February, May, July, September and October, with 70.7% in September. This figure describes observation support, not a monthly rainfall climatology.

Station mean rainfall and wet fraction on the same 3,976 calendar positions in each of eight years: 31,808 readings per station. S08 and S24 are the highest and lowest pooled mean rates on this restricted five-month support; ranking is not a full-year spatial result.
Longitude/latitude of the descriptive cohort, coloured by observed mean rainfall on restricted joint support. Markers are station measurements; no interpolation or spatial area weighting is applied.

Network conditional wet-reading p50/p90/p99 by year, using strictly positive five-minute amounts and percentile_approx with accuracy 10,000. Approximation concerns rank; these are not thirty-minute future-label quantiles and not estimates of missing-data uncertainty.
